definition: the horny part of the foot of a horse, antelope, and other ungulates; the hoof.
example: ಕುದುರೆಯ ಕುರ ಕಲ್ಲಿನ ಮೇಲೆ ಬಡಿದು ಸದ್ದು ಮಾಡಿತು.

definition: a learned or erudite person, esp. one who has profound knowledge of a particular subject; a scholar.
example: ಆ ಬಿಜ್ಜೆಗ ಗ್ರಂಥಗಳನ್ನು ಆಳವಾಗಿ ಅಧ್ಯಯನ ಮಾಡಿದನು.

definition: a small, round water container with a slightly narrow neck, made of metal, usu. copper.

definition: a woman who has authority, control or power, esp. the female head of an institution or other establishment; a mistress.

definition: a person whom hospitality is or is to be extended by another; a guest.

definition: a heap; an assemblage; a multitude, flock; a group in general.

definition: a wandering or touring widely in a country or in different countries.

definition: to smile broadly as in amusement or pleasure or, sometimes, in embarrassment; to grin.
example_en: Hearing his joke, everyone grinned broadly.

definition: a paramour of Manmatha, the love-God.
example_en: In mythology, Holi is described as the paramour of the love-god Manmatha.

definition: (collectively) dried sticks, twigs of plants.

definition: the Indian sub-continent, including the present India, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Burma, Sri Lanka and parts of Afghanistan.
example_en: The history of the Indian subcontinent is very ancient.

definition: to become demolished, destroyed completely.
example_en: The rock was completely destroyed by the lightning strike.

definition: a flat, stiff piece of thick paper; a paper board.

definition: the sun.

definition: great plenty; abundance.
example: ಆ ರಾಜ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಧಾನ್ಯದ ಋದ್ಧಿ ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಕಾಣುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.

definition: a piece of coarse fabric of plaited rushes, straw, etc., for sitting or lying on; a mat.

example_en: People rested in the shade of that cadamba tree.

definition: a screen to be set in front of a fireplace to protect against heat or sparks; a fire-screen.

definition: a piece of hard material, as wood or metal, tapering from a thick back to a thin edge that can be driven or forced into a narrow opening, as to split wood, close a fissure, etc.; a wedge.

definition: the act of shooting arrows.

example_en: He took advice from the guru in the time of trouble.

definition: born together or from the same parents.

definition: to push aside.

example: ಕಾಡಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಹಬ್ಬೆ ಬಳ್ಳಿಗಳು ಮರಗಳ ಮೇಲೆ ಹಬ್ಬಿದ್ದವು.
example_en: In the forest, rattan vines had spread over the trees.

definition: an increasing; growth.
example_en: With this fertilizer, growth of the crop occurs.

definition: a vine-drinking cup; a vine-glass.
example_en: They served drinks in wine-cups at the banquet.

definition: a lullaby - a) a song used to lull a child to sleep; a cradle song; b) any lulling song.
example: ತಾಯಿ ಮಗುವಿಗೆ ಜೋಗಳ ಹಾಡಿ ನಿದ್ರೆ ಮಾಡಿಸಿದಳು.
example_en: The mother sang a lullaby to the baby and put it to sleep.

definition: the ray-fish Raja binoculata of the genus Raja, having a pointed snout; a big skate.
example_en: A large skate was caught in the fishermen's net.

definition: a member of an ethnic group of Iranian stock living in Afghanistan, Tajikistan, and parts of Uzbekistan; Tajik.
example_en: That merchant was a Tajik.

definition: a type of palanqueen.
example: ಮದುವೆಯ ಮೆರವಣಿಗೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ವಧುವನ್ನು ಸಾದದಂಡಿಗೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕರೆದುಕೊಂಡು ಹೋದರು.
example_en: In the wedding procession, they carried the bride in a type of palanquin.

definition: the feeling of devotion charged with ecstasy.
example_en: The devotees sang the hymn dancing with ecstatic devotion.

definition: a towel or a piece of cloth for wiping or drying things; a hand-towel.
example_en: She wiped off her sweat with a hand-towel.

definition: a pushing down of stones and boulders in large numberson something.
example: ಗುಡ್ಡದ ಮೇಲಿನಿಂದ ಕಲ್ಗುಂಡುವಳೆ ಮನೆಗಳ ಮೇಲೆ ಬಿತ್ತು.
example_en: A pushing down of stones and boulders fell on the houses from the hill above.

definition: name of one of the Śaivaāgamas.
example_en: The Sahasragama describes the worship of Shiva.

definition: a musquito repellent usu. made in the form a coil, which contain a kind of active chemical, used to repel mosquitoes.
example: ರಾತ್ರಿ ಸೊಳ್ಳೆಗಳ ಹಿಂಸೆ ತಪ್ಪಿಸಲು ಅವಳು ಸೊಳ್ಳೆಬತ್ತಿ ಹಚ್ಚಿದಳು.
example_en: To escape the torment of mosquitoes at night she lit a mosquito coil.

definition: the concept of self, that gives the sense of individuality; the individual as self-aware; the ego.
example_en: Excessive ego ruined his relationships.

definition: a village, colony where hunters live.
example: ಕಾಡಿನ ಅಂಚಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಇರುವ ಬೇಡವಟ್ಟದಲ್ಲಿ ಬೇಟೆಗಾರರು ವಾಸಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: Hunters live in the hunters' colony at the edge of the forest.

definition: a food baked from a leavened, kneaded dough made with flour or meal, water, etc.; bread.
example_en: The aroma of the bread spread in the kitchen.

definition: a feeling of sickness at the stomach, with an impulse to vomit; nausea.
example_en: During the bus journey, she felt nauseous.

definition: jugglery - a) the art or an act of juggling; sleight of hand; b) trickery; deception.
example_en: At the fair he deceived the people with jugglery.

definition: something that cannot be done without; necessary thing; necessities.
example_en: We prepared the necessities needed for the journey beforehand.

definition: any of a number of soil-dwelling caterpillars (family Noctuidae) that feed on young plants of cabbage, corn, etc., cutting them off at ground level; a cut-worm.
example_en: The cut-worm cut off the stems of the young plants.

definition: making no sound; silently; mutely.
example_en: He went inside silently and sat down.

definition: to ignore; to disregard; to ignore; to treat contemptuously.
example_en: He disregarded my words.

definition: a residence other than one's normal or permanent one.
example_en: He spent a year in a foreign residence.
